title: Rabbi Chizkiyah bar Yaakov bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Sheviit 3:4, reporting in the name of Rabbi Yose, son of Rabbi Chanina. Hyman says that it appears the text should read “Rabbi Chizkiyah in the name of Rabbi Yose, son of Rabbi Chanina,” as in Berakhot 8:6.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman explains ב״ר here as בשם ר׳, “in the name of Rabbi,” not a patronymic. The proposed correction turns an apparent genealogy into a report formula.

The checked Sheviit 3:4 writes Rabbi Chizkiyah followed by Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha in the name of Rabbi Yosei ben Chanina; Berakhot 8:6 explicitly joins Chizkiyah and Yaakov bar Acha with “and.” These forms do not establish the genealogy in Hyman’s heading. His proposed reading of ב״ר as בשם ר׳ and his apparent-correction wording are preserved as his textual analysis, without canonical Hebrew or identity repair.
